[[File:Systems_control_droid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[PIP/2 systems control droid]]]]
'''Administrative droids''' also called '''Civil-service droid''' were first-degree [[Droid/Legends|droid]] models that functioned as secretaries and administrative assistants in a variety of settings and locations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The roles these droids were called upon to fulfill included the initiating of trade negotiations with commerce guilds or merchant houses, as well as serving as traveling aides. They were programmed with a high number of forms of communication and basic information for business issues.

Manufacturers who produced these types of droids included such companies as [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]], [[Genetech Corporation]], and [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]].
